coordinateSpace.origin: Granny Volt local source coordinates; y increases downward

measurementPolicy.anatomy: Manually annotated polygon encloses anatomical head/hair, neck, torso, pelvis, limbs and feet; excludes separate role headwear and handheld/carry props.
measurementPolicy.headwear: Each direction must list accessory polygons; use an empty list only when no separate headwear is present.
measurementPolicy.props: Each direction must list prop polygons; use an empty list only when no role prop is present.
measurementPolicy.bodyHeight: headTop through footBaseline inclusive; body polygon is separately recorded and should exclude detached headwear/props.
measurementPolicy.shoulderWidth: distance between anatomical shoulder landmarks at shoulderY; never use full sprite width.
measurementPolicy.dynamicPose: Runner uses explicit shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle landmarks; standing leg-height ratio is not computed.
measurementPolicy.thresholds: All ratios are descriptive. No provisional band is a hard-fail gate.

granny.note: Approved benchmark measurements imported as legacy reference facts. They are not yet a semantic-landmark annotation record; the umbrella canopy and shaft are excluded while gripping arm/hand remain included. Harmonize the semantic body/headwear mask before directly comparing new landmark ratios.
